conclusions: The existing stage log narrows the timeout to the candidate application start after preflight, stopping the owned services, and backup.
Most logged elapsed time precedes the first checkpoint and service stopping.
Repeated dependency fingerprinting is a measurement target, not a proven sole cause.
The final receipt and HTTP acceptance evidence are still absent.
clockLimitations: Stage elapsedSeconds starts when OwnedDiagnostics is created, not at systemd ExecMainStart.
Do not subtract a stage-log time from total systemd duration to infer backend.start latency.
No completed backend.start, HTTP acceptance, or final transaction receipt is proved.
nextMeasurementRequirements: Wrap the actual loaded gate instance used by the transaction.
Keep every existing validation and scan, without memoizing, skipping, retrying, or changing CPU/deadline limits.
Preserve exact return values and original exceptions; record only bounded timing, fixed labels, and call counts.
Add a monotonic clock anchor and start-RPC-return/post-validation boundaries before attributing the final timeout.
